+"""RoboPaint strict trajectory helper for the live eai-standard/2.2 episode."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import math
+import pathlib
+import sys
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path("/app/runs")
+ORI = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)  # vertical, tuft down
+DT = 0.05
+
+
+def client() -> Robot:
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def status(r: Robot) -> None:
+    print(json.dumps(r.status(), indent=2))
+
+
+def now_tip(r: Robot) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(cameras=[]).meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def path_rows(start: np.ndarray, points: list[np.ndarray], speed: float) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Densify tip waypoints to a bounded per-control-step Cartesian speed."""
+    poses = [np.asarray(start, dtype=float)]
+    for p in points:
+        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
+        n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(p[:3] - poses[-1][:3]) / (speed * DT))))
+        poses.extend(poses[-1] + (p - poses[-1]) * (i / n) for i in range(1, n + 1))
+    return np.asarray(poses[1:], dtype=np.float32)
+
+
+def pose(xyz, ori=ORI) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float), np.asarray(ori, dtype=float)]
+
+
+def execute(r: Robot, points, speed=0.10, dwell=0, note="", cameras=None):
+    start = now_tip(r)
+    final_points = [pose(p) if len(p) == 3 else np.asarray(p, dtype=float) for p in points]
+    rows = path_rows(start, final_points, speed)
+    if dwell:
+        rows = np.vstack([rows, np.repeat(rows[-1][None, :], int(round(dwell / DT)), axis=0)])
+    print(f"{note}: {len(rows)} rows, start={start[:3].round(4).tolist()}, end={rows[-1,:3].round(4).tolist()}")
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=DT, video="mp4", cameras=cameras, note=note)
+    dest = OUT / f"{r.status()['calls']:03d}_{note.replace(' ', '_')}"
+    res.save(str(dest))
+    print("RESULT", json.dumps({"meta": res.meta, "saved": str(dest)}, default=str)[:2000])
+    return res
+
+
+def dip(r: Robot):
+    start = now_tip(r)
+    # The scene-camera depth places the ink well near (-0.10, +0.15, 0.03).
+    execute(r, [(start[0], start[1], 0.16), (-0.10, 0.15, 0.16),
+                (-0.10, 0.15, 0.025)], speed=0.10, dwell=0.5,
+            note="ink_dip", cameras=["scene_cam", "side_cam"])
+    execute(r, [(-0.10, 0.15, 0.16)], speed=0.08, note="lift_after_dip",
+            cameras=["scene_cam", "side_cam"])
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        print("usage: gen.py status|dip|practice")
+        return
+    r = client()
+    cmd = sys.argv[1]
+    if cmd == "status":
+        status(r)
+    elif cmd == "dip":
+        dip(r)
+        status(r)
+    elif cmd == "practice":
+        # Three parallel 50 mm test strokes on the unscored sheet. They share
+        # the character's vertical brush orientation and vary only press depth.
+        lanes = [(-0.145, 0.014), (-0.1856, 0.009), (-0.226, 0.004)]
+        for i, (y, z) in enumerate(lanes, 1):
+            execute(r, [(-0.075, y, 0.06), (-0.075, y, z),
+                        (-0.125, y, z), (-0.125, y, 0.06)], speed=0.035,
+                    note=f"practice_{i}", cameras=["practice_cam", "side_cam"])
+        status(r)
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit(f"unknown stage: {cmd}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage
cam=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/runs/056_clear_canvas_to_ink_side_1/last/canvas_cam.jpg').convert('RGB'))
target=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('L'))<128
labs,n=ndimage.label(target,np.ones((3,3),int));print('target components',n,[int((labs==i).sum()) for i in range(1,n+1)])
# canvas cam paper square measures 888 px for 1024 target px, centered at 512
s=888.0/1024
v,u=np.indices(target.shape); coords=np.array([512+(v.ravel()-512)*s,512+(u.ravel()-512)*s])
# bilinear sample the camera's coverage threshold proxy, with 0=paper, 1=dark ink
cam_dark=(cam.max(2)<128).astype(np.float32)
actual=(ndimage.map_coordinates(cam_dark,coords,order=1,mode='constant',cval=0).reshape(target.shape)>=0.5)
# restrict to central exemplar region, excluding left-side robot pixels while retaining any real character pixels
roi=np.zeros_like(target);roi[250:760,200:830]=True
actual &= roi
# smooth 1-pixel rasterization artifacts without moving silhouette much
for dx in range(-22,23):
 for dy in range(-22,23):
  sh=np.zeros_like(actual)
  sy0=max(0,dy);sy1=min(1024,1024+dy);sx0=max(0,dx);sx1=min(1024,1024+dx)
  sh[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1]=actual[sy0-dy:sy1-dy,sx0-dx:sx1-dx]
  inter=np.count_nonzero(sh&target); union=np.count_nonzero(sh|target)
  iou=inter/union if union else 0
  if dx==-22 and dy==-22: best=(iou,dx,dy,inter,union)
  elif iou>best[0]:best=(iou,dx,dy,inter,union)
print('actual area',int(actual.sum()),'target area',int(target.sum()),'best IoU/dx/dy/inter/union',best)
# apply best whole-pixel registration to ink
_,dx,dy,_,_=best
sh=np.zeros_like(actual);sy0=max(0,dy);sy1=min(1024,1024+dy);sx0=max(0,dx);sx1=min(1024,1024+dx);sh[sy0:sy1,sx0:sx1]=actual[sy0-dy:sy1-dy,sx0-dx:sx1-dx]
# boundary F within 1 mm = 4.51 pixels
r=1000/PIX if False else 1.0/0.22186
rad=int(np.ceil(r))
structure=ndimage.generate_binary_structure(2,1)
bt=target & ~ndimage.binary_erosion(target,structure=structure)
ba=sh & ~ndimage.binary_erosion(sh,structure=structure)
dt=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(~bt); da=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(~ba)
p=np.count_nonzero(ba & (dt<=r))/max(1,ba.sum()); rec=np.count_nonzero(bt & (da<=r))/max(1,bt.sum()); F=2*p*rec/(p+rec) if p+rec else 0
print('boundary precision recall F',round(p,4),round(rec,4),round(F,4),'boundaries',int(ba.sum()),int(bt.sum()))
for i in range(1,n+1):
 t=labs==i;print('region',i,'coverage',round(np.count_nonzero(sh&t)/t.sum(),4),'area',int(t.sum()))
dout=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(~target)
stray=np.count_nonzero(sh & (dout>r));print('stray fraction/area',round(stray/target.sum(),5),int(stray))
# approximate mean widths and total ink area in mm^2
print('ink area mm2',round(actual.sum()*0.22186**2,1),'path approx mm',70.67+86.81,'mark_width approx',round(actual.sum()*0.22186**2/(70.67+86.81),2))
# per region overlap before registration and bounding boxes
for i in range(1,n+1):
 c=labs==i;y,x=np.where(c);print('target bbox',i,(x.min(),y.min(),x.max(),y.max()))

 dt=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(~bt);da=ndimage.distance_transform_edt(~ba)

 print(threshold_name,'area',int(actual.sum()),'IoU',round(iou,4),'shift',dx,dy,'F',round(F,4),'P/R',round(p,4),round(rec,4),'cov',*[round(x,4) for x in cov],'stray',round(stray,4))
